title: The Three Strategies of Huang Shigong — Sanlüe (English)
summary: A complete English reading of the Three Strategies of Huang Shigong: Upper, Middle and Lower, some 3,800 characters, one of the Seven Military Classics and the book the Yellow Stone Elder is said to have handed Zhang Liang on the bridge at Xiapi. Collated character by character against the Siku quanshu plain text and against the classic text carried in Liu Yin’s Ming commentary, with the 1604 Fushimi movable-type printing read at the decisive places.
